props.name: onClose
props.description: Called by the close button, and by Escape while focus is inside the panel.

props.name: title
props.description: Title in the drag bar. Becomes the accessible name.

props.name: defaultPosition
props.description: Where the panel first appears. Defaults to the top right corner.

props.name: onPositionChange
props.description: Called when a move ends, by pointer or keyboard. Store it to reopen the panel where it was left.

props.name: onMinimizedChange
props.description: Called when the panel is minimised or restored.

props.name: autoFocus
props.description: Move focus into the panel when it opens.
